title: Trading pieces
intro: When you are ahead, every trade brings the win closer. Learn to force trades and to see when the pawn ending is won.

lessons.title: Trade queens when you are ahead
lessons.summary: A check that offers the trade cannot be refused.

steps.text: White is a pawn up, but with queens on the board Black can give checks for ever. Trading queens ends that, and White's king and pawns win the ending.
Offer the trade with check, so Black has no choice.
steps.hint: Find a queen check on the diagonal towards h7, on a square the black queen also reaches.
steps.ifWrong: Put your queen where it gives check and faces the black queen.
steps.ifRight: Queens are off, and the extra pawn will decide.

steps.text: The same idea: force the queen trade with check.
steps.hint: Which check also offers your queen to the black one?
steps.ifRight: After the trade, the d-pawn cannot be stopped.

lessons.title: Trade into a won pawn ending
lessons.summary: With the more active king, the last trade wins.

steps.text: Black's king on d5 is far more active than White's. If the bishops come off, the king walks in and eats pawns. Trades help the side with the better king.
Trade bishops and let your king in.
steps.hint: Take the pawn on d4 with the bishop.
steps.ifWrong: Capture on d4 with the bishop.
steps.ifRight: The pawn ending is easily won: the king is already in.

steps.text: Again: one trade and the king walks in.
steps.ifWrong: Take on f4 with the bishop first.
steps.ifRight: Black's king takes the f-pawn and the ending is won.
